me.uploadDone.input.transcript: Every November, Delhi's air turns. Three things meet: farm fires upwind, cooler air that traps smoke near the ground, and the city's own traffic and building dust. On Monday readings passed 450, the 'severe' level, so the emergency rules started: building work stops, diesel trucks stay out, and offices are asked to let people work from home. Delhi's primary schools moved online; schools in Noida and Gurugram stayed open. Sources are under the video.

still.description: A smoggy Delhi street at dawn, a roadside board reading AQI 452
